Importing data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(ausflora)

euc_names <- read.csv("data/name_matched_list.csv", header=T)

euc_coords <- read.csv("data/eucs_with_uncertainty.csv", header=T) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  filter(scientificName %in% euc_names$current_name,
         coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= 10000,
         year >= 1900) |> 
  rename(current_name = scientificName)

euc_sp <- vect(euc_coords, geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"))

```

```{r}
xylem_areas <- list.files("area_data/", full.names = T) |> 
  map_df(read.csv, header = T) |> 
  separate(Image, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |> 
  separate(other, c("species", "state", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |> 
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000)

resources <- load_taxonomic_resources()

namematched <- create_taxonomic_update_lookup(xylem_areas$species, 
                                                     resources = resources)
xylem_areas <- xylem_areas |> left_join(namematched[,c(1,3)], by = c("species" = "original_name"))

```

Zanne et al. (2010) comparison
```{r}
zanne_data <- read.csv("data/zanne_data.csv", header = T)
zanne_native <- native_anywhere_in_australia(zanne_data$Binomial, 
                                             resources = resources) |> 
  right_join(zanne_data, by = c("species" = "Binomial")) |> 
  filter(native_anywhere_in_aus == "TRUE" )

jugo_data <- xylem_areas |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  mutate(total_area = sum(area_mm, na.rm=T)) |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  summarise(n=n(),
         mean_area = mean(area_mm, na.rm=T),
         log_mean_area = log(mean_area),
         sd_area = sd(log(area_mm)),
         n_per_area = n/total_area,
         area_n_ratio = mean_area/n_per_area) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  left_join(xylem_areas[, c(1:2)], by = "species") |> 
  distinct()

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = zanne_data, aes(x = N, y = A), col = "light grey") +
  # geom_point(data = zanne_native, aes(x = N, y = A), col = "black") +
  geom_point(data = jugo_data, aes(x = n_per_area, y = mean_area, col = family)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_classic()
```


Creating climate preference data
```{r}
occurrences <- list.files("occurrences/", full.names = T)
occurrence_data <- occurrences |> map_df(read.csv, header = T) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  rename(species = scientificName)

occurrence_points <- vect(occurrence_data, geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"))

raster_list <- list.files("rasters_30s/", full.names = T) |> map(rast)

for (raster in raster_list) {
  occurrence_data <- occurrence_data |> 
    mutate(!!sym(names(raster)) := terra::extract(raster, occurrence_points)[[2]])
}

climate_preferences <- occurrence_data |> 
  group_by(species) |>  
  summarise(mean_MAP=mean(MAP, na.rm=T), 
            tenth_MAP=quantile(MAP, c(0.1, 0.9), na.rm=T)[1],
            sd_log_MAP=sd(log(MAP), na.rm=T),
            MAT=mean(MAT, na.rm=T),
            seasonality=mean(seasonality, na.rm=T),
            wet_quarter=mean(wet_quarter, na.rm=T),
            dry_quarter=mean(dry_quarter, na.rm=T),
            AI=mean(awi_pm_sr_yr/10000, na.rm=T),
            n=n()) |> 
  mutate(climate=cut(AI, breaks=c(-Inf, 0.03, 0.2, 0.5, 0.65, Inf), 
                     labels=c("Hyper Arid", "Arid", "Semi-Arid", "Dry sub-humid", "Humid"))) |> 
  filter(n > 5) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  filter(species %in% namematched$apc_name) 
  
write.csv(climate_preferences, "data/climate_preferences.csv", row.names = F)
```

Area climate plot
```{r}
climate_vars <- names(database_by_species[3:10])

lm_climate <- function(var) {
  # print(dataset)
  plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data=euc_n, aes_string(x=var, y="mean_area")) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme_bw()
  
  print(plot)
  
  lm_function <- paste(sprintf("log(mean_area)~log(%s)", var))
  # print(lm_function)
  data_lm <- lm(lm_function, data = euc_n)
  performance::r2(data_lm)[[1]]
  # print(data_lm)
}


climate_vars |> map(lm_climate)


```

Calculating Hydraulically weighted diameter Dh
```{r}
xylem_Dh <- euc_database |> 
  filter(Name=="vessel") |> 
  mutate(r5 = radius^5,
         r4 = radius^4) |> 
  group_by(current_name, other) |> 
  summarise(Dh = sum(r5)/ sum(r4)) |> 
  group_by(current_name) |> 
  summarise(mean_Dh = mean(Dh, na.rm=T)) |> 
  #group_by(current_name) |> 
  #summarise(mean_Dh = mean(Dh, na.rm=T)) |> 
  left_join(euc_climate_data, by = "current_name") |> 
  drop_na()

```

```{r}
Dh_regression = list()

for (var in climate_vars) {
  formula <- paste(sprintf("log(mean_Dh)~log(%s)", var))
  Dh_regression[[var]] <- lm(formula, data = xylem_Dh)
}

for (lm in Dh_regression) {
  print(summary(lm))
  plot(lm, which=2)
  hist(lm$residuals)
}
```


```{r}
Dh_plots = list()

for (var in climate_vars) {
  Dh_plots[[var]] <- xylem_Dh |> 
    ggplot(aes_string(x = var, y = "mean_Dh")) + geom_point() + 
    scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10()
}

#for (plot in Dh_plots) {
#  plot(plot)
#}

Dh_plots$mean_MAP + Dh_plots$AI
ggsave("figures/Dh_MAP.jpg", width = 10, height = 5)


```


Calculating lumen fractions
```{r}
xylem_lumen <- euc_database |> 
  group_by(current_name, other, Name) |> 
  summarise(total_area = sum(Area.µm.2, na.rm=T)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Name, values_from = total_area) |> 
  mutate(lumen_frac = (part+vessel)/PathAnnotationObject) |> 
  #group_by(current_name) |> 
  #summarise(mean_lumen_frac = mean(lumen_frac, na.rm=T),
  #         SE = sd(lumen_frac)/sqrt(n())) |> 
  left_join(euc_climate_data, by = c("current_name" = "scientificName")) |> 
  mutate(highly_seasonal = seasonality > 60) |> 
  drop_na()

```


```{r}
lumen_regression = list()

for (var in climate_vars) {
  formula <- paste(sprintf("sqrt(lumen_frac)~sqrt(%s)", var))
  lumen_regression[[var]] <- lm(formula, data = xylem_lumen)
}

for (lm in lumen_regression) {
  print(summary(lm))
  plot(lm, which=2)
  hist(lm$residuals)
}

```


```{r}
lumen_plots = list()

for (var in climate_vars) {
  lumen_plots[[var]] <- xylem_lumen |> 
    ggplot(aes_string(x = var, y = "lumen_frac")) + geom_point() + scale_x_sqrt() +
    scale_y_sqrt()
}

for (plot in lumen_plots) {
  plot(plot)
}

lumen_plots$mean_MAP + lumen_plots$min_MAP
ggsave("figures/lumen_MAP.jpg", width = 10, height = 5)
```


Comparing Dh to lumen fraction
```{r}
species_summary <- xylem_Dh |> 
  left_join(xylem_lumen[,c(2,6)], by = "other") 

Dh_lumen_plot <- species_summary |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = lumen_frac, y = Dh)) + 
  geom_point()

plot(Dh_lumen_plot)

Dh_lumen_lm <- lm(Dh~lumen_frac, data = species_summary)
summary(Dh_lumen_lm)
hist(Dh_lumen_lm$residuals)

Dh_lumen_lm
ggsave("figures/lumen_Dh.jpg", width = 5, height = 5)
```

PCA
```{r}
library(vegan)

species_standardised <- species_summary |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::select(-c(1,2,10)) |> 
  scale() 

xylem_PCA <- princomp(species_standardised, cor = FALSE)
screeplot(xylem_PCA, type = "lines")
summary(xylem_PCA)
loadings(xylem_PCA)
biplot(xylem_PCA)

ggsave("figures/lumen_Dh.jpg", width = 5, height = 5)
```
